words.enDefinition: the organ system of the heart and blood vessels that circulates blood through the lungs and body tissues

examples.en: The cardiovascular system chart shows how blood moves between the heart, lungs and the rest of the body.
examples.zh: 「心血管系统」图显示血液如何在心脏、肺和全身其他部位之间流动。

examples.en: Our lecturer used colored arrows to show the two major circuits of the cardiovascular system.
examples.zh: 老师用彩色箭头在「心血管系统」图中表示两大循环。

words.enDefinition: blood flow from the right ventricle through the lungs and back to the left atrium

examples.en: The pulmonary circulation starts at the right ventricle and returns blood to the left atrium in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们的图中，「肺循环」始于右心室，将血液送回左心房。

examples.en: We traced pulmonary circulation through the capillaries surrounding the alveoli on the model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在模型上沿肺泡周围的毛细血管追踪「肺循环」。

words.enDefinition: blood flow from the left ventricle through the body tissues and back to the right atrium

examples.en: The large aortic arrow marks the beginning of systemic circulation in the classroom heart model.
examples.zh: 课堂心脏模型上，那支较大的主动脉箭头标出「体循环」的起点。

examples.en: We traced systemic circulation from the left ventricle through a tissue capillary bed to the right atrium.
examples.zh: 我们从左心室经组织毛细血管床追踪到右心房，观察「体循环」。

words.enDefinition: the flow of blood through vessels supplying and draining the tissues of the heart itself

examples.en: The lecture diagram distinguishes coronary circulation from the blood passing through the chambers of the heart.
examples.zh: 讲义图区分了「冠状循环」与流经心脏各腔的血流。

examples.en: We traced coronary circulation from an aortic branch to small vessels within the heart wall.
examples.zh: 我们从主动脉的一个分支追踪到心壁内的小血管，观察「冠状循环」。

words.enDefinition: the pointed inferior tip of the heart, formed mainly by the left ventricle

examples.en: The cardiac apex points downward and to the left in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型的前视图中，「心尖」指向左下方。

examples.en: We rotated the heart model until the cardiac apex and the broad base were both visible.
examples.zh: 我们转动心脏模型，直到「心尖」和较宽的心底都可见。

words.enDefinition: the tough outer connective tissue layer of the sac surrounding the heart

examples.en: The fibrous pericardium formed the outermost layer of the heart's protective sac on the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂图中，「纤维心包」构成心脏保护囊的最外层。

examples.en: We labeled the fibrous pericardium outside the thinner lining on the enlarged section in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们在图谱的放大切面上，在较薄衬层外侧标出了「纤维心包」。

words.enDefinition: the two-layered serous membrane lining the fibrous sac and covering the outer surface of the heart

examples.en: The model shows the serous pericardium reflected from the inner sac onto the surface of the heart.
examples.zh: 模型显示，「浆膜心包」从囊内衬向心脏表面反折。

examples.en: We colored both layers of the serous pericardium before labeling the narrow space between them in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先给「浆膜心包」的两层着色，再标出两层间的狭窄空间。

collocations: parietal layer of the serous pericardium
visceral layer of the serous pericardium

words.enDefinition: the outer layer of the heart wall, incorporating the visceral layer of the serous pericardium

examples.en: The atlas draws the epicardium over the myocardium on the outside of the sectioned heart wall.
examples.zh: 图谱在心壁切面中，将「心外膜」画在心肌层外侧。

examples.en: We identified the epicardium by following the surface layer around the edge of the heart model.
examples.zh: 我们沿着心脏模型边缘的表层辨认「心外膜」。

words.enDefinition: the muscular middle layer of the heart wall whose contraction pumps blood

examples.en: The myocardium was thicker around the left ventricle than around the right ventricle on the sectioned model.
examples.zh: 在剖开的模型上，左心室周围的「心肌层」比右心室周围厚。

examples.en: Our diagram shows blood vessels running into the myocardium to supply the contracting tissue with oxygen.
examples.zh: 图中血管进入「心肌层」，为收缩的组织供氧。

words.enDefinition: the smooth inner lining of the chambers of the heart, continuous with the lining of blood vessels

examples.en: The endocardium lines the ventricular cavity in the labeled section of the classroom heart model.
examples.zh: 在有标记的课堂心脏模型切面上，「心内膜」衬在心室腔里面。

examples.en: We followed the endocardium from the chamber wall onto the surface of a valve leaflet.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「心内膜」从心腔壁看到瓣叶表面。

words.enDefinition: the heart chamber that receives blood from systemic veins and passes it to the right ventricle

examples.en: The two large systemic veins enter the right atrium at different levels on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型上，两条较大的体循环静脉从不同高度进入「右心房」。

examples.en: An arrow shows blood passing from the right atrium through the tricuspid valve in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中箭头表示血液从「右心房」经过三尖瓣。

words.enDefinition: the heart chamber receiving blood from the pulmonary veins and passing it to the left ventricle

examples.en: The posterior view shows several pulmonary veins entering the left atrium on the model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂模型的后视图显示，多条肺静脉进入「左心房」。

examples.en: We traced the arrow from the left atrium through the mitral valve into the ventricle below.
examples.zh: 我们沿箭头从「左心房」经过二尖瓣追踪到下方的心室。

words.enDefinition: the heart chamber that pumps blood into the pulmonary trunk toward the lungs

examples.en: We followed the right ventricle outlet to the pulmonary trunk on the labeled model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在有标记的模型中从「右心室」出口追踪至肺动脉干。

examples.en: The wall of the right ventricle is thinner than the wall of the left in our section.
examples.zh: 在我们观察的切面上，「右心室」壁比左心室壁薄。

collocations: blood ejected by the right ventricle

words.enDefinition: the heart chamber that ejects blood into the aorta to supply the systemic circulation

examples.en: The left ventricle pumps blood past the aortic valve into the first part of the aorta.
examples.zh: 「左心室」泵出的血液通过主动脉瓣进入主动脉的起始段。

examples.en: In the cutaway model, a thick muscle wall surrounds the cavity of the left ventricle.
examples.zh: 在剖视模型中，较厚的肌肉壁围绕着「左心室」腔。

collocations: blood ejected by the left ventricle

words.enDefinition: the partition separating the right and left atria of the heart

examples.en: The interatrial septum forms the partition between the two upper chambers on our model in class.
examples.zh: 课堂模型上，「房间隔」构成两个上方心腔之间的隔壁。

examples.en: We located the interatrial septum by tracing the medial walls of both atria on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们沿着图中两个心房的内侧壁找到「房间隔」。

words.enDefinition: the partition between the right and left ventricles, mainly composed of heart muscle

examples.en: The interventricular septum appeared between the ventricular cavities on the cross section shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的横切面上，「室间隔」位于两处心室腔之间。

examples.en: We traced the muscular part of the interventricular septum down toward the tip of the heart.
examples.zh: 我们沿「室间隔」的肌性部分向下追踪到心尖附近。

collocations: membranous part of the interventricular septum

words.enDefinition: the large vein returning blood mainly from tissues above the diaphragm to the right atrium

examples.en: The superior vena cava enters the right atrium from above in the labeled front view.
examples.zh: 在有标记的前视图中，「上腔静脉」从上方进入右心房。

examples.en: We traced the superior vena cava upward toward veins that drain the head and upper limbs.
examples.zh: 我们从「上腔静脉」向上追踪到引流头部与上肢的静脉。

collocations: tributaries of the superior vena cava
blood flowing through the superior vena cava

words.enDefinition: the large vein returning blood mainly from below the diaphragm to the right atrium

examples.en: The classroom chart shows the inferior vena cava carrying blood upward from the lower body.
examples.zh: 课堂图表显示，「下腔静脉」将下半身的血液向上运送。

examples.en: We identified the inferior vena cava as the large vessel entering the right atrium from below.
examples.zh: 我们把从下方进入右心房的大血管标为「下腔静脉」。

collocations: tributaries of the inferior vena cava
blood flowing through the inferior vena cava

words.enDefinition: the large vessel leaving the right ventricle before dividing into the right and left pulmonary arteries

examples.en: The pulmonary trunk branches into two large vessels just beyond the heart in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「肺动脉干」离开心脏不远便分成两条大血管。

examples.en: We followed blood through the pulmonary valve before it entered the pulmonary trunk on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上追踪血液先经过肺动脉瓣，再进入「肺动脉干」。

words.enDefinition: a vessel carrying blood from the right side of the heart toward a lung

examples.en: In the adult circulation diagram, the pulmonary artery carries blood with relatively low oxygen content.
examples.zh: 在成人血液循环图中，「肺动脉」输送的是氧含量相对较低的血液。

examples.en: We found the right pulmonary artery by following the branch from the pulmonary trunk toward that lung.
examples.zh: 我们从肺动脉干沿通往右肺的分支找到右「肺动脉」。

words.enDefinition: a vessel carrying blood from a lung to the left atrium

examples.en: The pulmonary vein returns oxygenated blood to the heart in the adult circulation diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂所用的成人血液循环图中，「肺静脉」将含氧血送回心脏。

examples.en: We traced a pulmonary vein from its lung attachment to an opening in the left atrium.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「肺静脉」从肺侧连接处追踪到左心房上的一个开口。

collocations: blood carried by a pulmonary vein

words.enDefinition: the first segment of the aorta, rising from the aortic valve to the aortic arch

examples.en: We traced the ascending aorta from the valve to the point where it began arching backward.
examples.zh: 我们从瓣膜沿「升主动脉」追踪到它开始向后弯曲的位置。

examples.en: The first coronary branches arise near the beginning of the ascending aorta in the labeled illustration.
examples.zh: 在标注图中，最初的冠状动脉分支起于「升主动脉」的起始段附近。

words.enDefinition: the curved portion of the aorta between its ascending and descending portions

examples.en: The classroom drawing shows several arteries branching from the upper surface of the aortic arch.
examples.zh: 课堂图画出了从「主动脉弓」上缘分出的几条动脉。

examples.en: We followed the aortic arch backward and leftward before continuing down the descending aorta on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上沿「主动脉弓」向后、向左追踪，然后沿降主动脉向下。

words.enDefinition: an artery arising from the aorta that supplies blood to heart muscle and related structures

examples.en: The coronary artery branches across the surface of the heart in the illustration beside the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型旁的图中，「冠状动脉」在心脏表面分支。

examples.en: We separated the drawing of each coronary artery from the veins returning blood from the heart wall.
examples.zh: 我们把各「冠状动脉」与从心壁回流血液的静脉分开绘制。

words.enDefinition: a large venous channel that collects most of the heart's venous blood and empties into the right atrium

examples.en: The rear view of the model marks the coronary sinus where several cardiac veins converge.
examples.zh: 模型的后视图在几条心静脉汇合处标出了「冠状窦」。

examples.en: We followed blood from the coronary sinus into the right atrium at the end of the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习最后，我们追踪血液从「冠状窦」进入右心房。

words.enDefinition: a valve between an atrium and a ventricle that helps prevent flow back into the atrium

examples.en: The diagram shows an atrioventricular valve opening as blood flows from an atrium into its ventricle.
examples.zh: 图中显示，血液从心房流向相应心室时，所示「房室瓣」打开。

examples.en: We identified each atrioventricular valve by locating the junction between its atrium and ventricle.
examples.zh: 我们在每组心房与心室的连接处辨认出相应的「房室瓣」。

words.enDefinition: the right atrioventricular valve, typically with three leaflets, between the right atrium and right ventricle

examples.en: The tricuspid valve separates the two right heart chambers in the colored cross section shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的彩色切面中，「三尖瓣」将两个右侧心腔分隔开。

examples.en: We counted the three leaflets of the tricuspid valve on the enlarged model of the right heart.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的右心模型上数出了「三尖瓣」的三片瓣叶。

words.enDefinition: the left atrioventricular valve, with two leaflets, between the left atrium and left ventricle

examples.en: The mitral valve opened when left atrial pressure exceeded left ventricular pressure in the simulation.
examples.zh: 模拟中，左心房压力超过左心室压力时，「二尖瓣」打开。

examples.en: We compared the two leaflets of the mitral valve with three on the right side.
examples.zh: 我们将「二尖瓣」的两片瓣叶与右侧的三片作了对比。

words.enDefinition: one of the valves at the ventricular outlets, with pocket-shaped cusps that prevent backward blood flow

examples.en: Three pocket-shaped cusps form the semilunar valve shown at the ventricular outlet in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，心室出口所示的「半月瓣」由三个袋形瓣尖构成。

examples.en: We compared a semilunar valve with a valve between an atrium and its ventricle in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们对比了「半月瓣」与位于心房和心室之间的一处瓣膜。

words.enDefinition: the semilunar valve between the right ventricle and the pulmonary trunk

examples.en: The pulmonary valve opens when right ventricular pressure exceeds pressure in the trunk during the animation.
examples.zh: 动画中，右心室压力高于肺动脉干压力时，「肺动脉瓣」打开。

examples.en: We located the pulmonary valve directly above the outlet of the right ventricle in the cutaway.
examples.zh: 我们在剖视图右心室出口的正上方找到了「肺动脉瓣」。

collocations: blood passing through the pulmonary valve

words.enDefinition: the semilunar valve between the left ventricle and the aorta

examples.en: The aortic valve closes to limit backward flow as the left ventricle relaxes in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 在课堂动画中，左心室舒张时，「主动脉瓣」关闭以限制血液回流。

examples.en: We placed the aortic valve label at the outlet from the chamber with the thicker wall.
examples.zh: 我们把「主动脉瓣」标签放在壁较厚的心室的出口处。

words.enDefinition: fibrous cords connecting atrioventricular valve leaflets to papillary muscles in the ventricles

examples.en: The chordae tendineae connect the valve leaflets to small muscular projections in the ventricular model.
examples.zh: 在心室模型中，「腱索」把瓣叶连到肌肉形成的小突起上。

examples.en: In the animation, the chordae tendineae limit backward bulging of the leaflets as ventricular pressure rises.
examples.zh: 动画中，心室压力升高时，「腱索」限制瓣叶向后膨出。

words.enDefinition: a ventricular muscle projection that pulls on chordae tendineae during contraction to help prevent valve leaflet prolapse

examples.en: The drawing shows each papillary muscle projecting from the ventricular wall beneath the valve leaflets.
examples.zh: 图中，各「乳头肌」从瓣叶下方的心室壁突出。

examples.en: We watched the papillary muscle contract as the ventricular wall began squeezing in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中心室壁开始收缩时，我们观察到「乳头肌」收缩。

words.enDefinition: the network of specialized cardiac cells that initiates and spreads electrical activity to coordinate the heartbeat

examples.en: The cardiac conduction system diagram arrows run from the upper chamber region toward the ventricular walls.
examples.zh: 「心脏传导系统」图中的箭头从上方心腔区域指向心室壁。

examples.en: We traced the cardiac conduction system on a separate illustration before discussing how the heart chambers contract.
examples.zh: 我们先在单独的图中追踪「心脏传导系统」，再讨论心腔如何收缩。

collocations: activation of the cardiac conduction system

words.enDefinition: the cluster of cells in the right atrium that normally initiates each heartbeat

examples.en: The animation starts electrical activation at the sinoatrial node near the upper right atrium in the model.
examples.zh: 模型动画中的电激动从靠近右心房上部的「窦房结」开始。

examples.en: We marked the sinoatrial node before tracing the signal across the atrial walls in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先标出「窦房结」，再沿心房壁追踪信号。

words.enDefinition: the conduction tissue that normally delays signals from the atria before they reach the ventricles

examples.en: The atrioventricular node delays electrical conduction briefly between atrial and ventricular activation in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 在课堂动画中，房室之间的电传导在「房室结」处有短暂延迟。

examples.en: We identified the atrioventricular node near the lower part of the interatrial septum on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中房间隔下部附近找到了「房室结」。

words.enDefinition: the conduction pathway carrying impulses from the atrioventricular node toward the ventricular bundle branches

examples.en: The arrow from the node follows the atrioventricular bundle into the upper ventricular septum in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，从结点出发的箭头沿「房室束」进入室间隔上部。

examples.en: We labeled the atrioventricular bundle before showing its division into two branches in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型上，我们先标出「房室束」，再展示它分为两支。

words.enDefinition: one of the right or left pathways conducting impulses down the ventricular septum toward the ventricles

examples.en: The diagram marks each bundle branch on its own side of the interventricular septum in the model.
examples.zh: 图中在室间隔相应的一侧标出了各条「束支」。

examples.en: We followed a bundle branch down the septum before tracing the network spreading through the ventricular wall.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「束支」下行到室间隔深处，接着追踪分布于心室壁的传导网络。

words.enDefinition: a specialized cardiac conduction fiber that rapidly carries electrical activation through parts of the ventricular walls

examples.en: The atlas shows a Purkinje fiber near the inner surface of the ventricle in the stained section.
examples.zh: 图谱的染色切片中，「浦肯野纤维」位于心室内表面附近。

examples.en: We traced a Purkinje fiber from the conduction network toward nearby cardiac muscle cells in the sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图上从传导网络沿一条「浦肯野纤维」追踪到附近的心肌细胞。

words.enDefinition: the spread of electrical activation across the atrial muscle before atrial contraction

examples.en: The first small wave in the drawing represents atrial depolarization before the atria contract in the model.
examples.zh: 模型图中的第一个小波表示心房收缩前的「心房去极化」。

examples.en: The classroom animation highlights the spread of atrial depolarization from the right atrium across both upper chambers.
examples.zh: 课堂动画突出显示「心房去极化」从右心房向两个上方心腔传播。

collocations: atrial depolarization on an ECG trace

words.enDefinition: electrical activation spreading across the ventricular muscle before its coordinated contraction

examples.en: The tall group of deflections on our example trace corresponds to ventricular depolarization in the heart model.
examples.zh: 示例曲线上一组较大的波形偏转，对应心脏模型中的「心室去极化」。

examples.en: We placed ventricular depolarization before the pressure rise on the combined electrical and mechanical timeline.
examples.zh: 在综合电活动与机械活动的时间线上，我们把「心室去极化」标在压力上升之前。

collocations: ventricular depolarization on an ECG trace

words.enDefinition: the return of ventricular muscle cells toward their resting electrical state after depolarization

examples.en: The last broad wave in the classroom trace reflects ventricular repolarization after the earlier activation of the ventricles.
examples.zh: 课堂曲线的最后一个宽波表示先前受电激动的心室发生「心室复极化」。

examples.en: We colored ventricular repolarization separately from activation on the simplified timeline of electrical events in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在简化的电活动时间线上用不同颜色标记「心室复极化」与激动。

collocations: ventricular repolarization on an ECG trace

words.enDefinition: the electrocardiogram deflection representing atrial depolarization

examples.en: We marked the P wave before the larger ventricular deflections on the classroom's example recording.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示例记录中，在较大的心室相关偏转之前标出了「P 波」。

examples.en: The P wave on the trace appeared when the animation showed electrical activity crossing both atria.
examples.zh: 动画显示电活动扫过两个心房时，曲线上出现了「P 波」。

words.enDefinition: the group of deflections on an electrocardiogram representing ventricular depolarization

examples.en: The QRS complex coincided with electrical activation of the ventricles on our synchronized classroom display.
examples.zh: 在同步展示的课堂图上，「QRS 波群」与心室电激动同时出现。

examples.en: We drew a bracket around the QRS complex to distinguish it from the waves before and after.
examples.zh: 我们用括号标出「QRS 波群」，以便与前后的波形区分。

words.enDefinition: the electrocardiogram wave representing ventricular repolarization

examples.en: The T wave appeared after the main ventricular complex in the sample trace discussed in class.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论的示例曲线上，「T 波」出现在主要的心室波群之后。

examples.en: We linked the T wave to the return of ventricular cells toward their resting electrical state.
examples.zh: 我们把「T 波」与心室细胞逐渐恢复到静息电状态联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the time from the start of the P wave to the start of the QRS complex on an electrocardiogram

examples.en: We marked the PR interval from P wave onset to the onset of the corresponding QRS complex.
examples.zh: 我们标出了从 P 波起点到相应 QRS 波群起点的「PR 间期」。

examples.en: The class measured PR interval durations from the time grid on a supplied sample recording.
examples.zh: 全班用给出的示例记录上的时间网格，测量「PR 间期」的时长。

words.enDefinition: the sequence of electrical and mechanical events from the start of one heartbeat to the start of the next

examples.en: The cardiac cycle chart aligns valve movements, pressure changes and electrical activity on a shared time axis.
examples.zh: 「心动周期」图在同一时间轴上对齐瓣膜运动、压力变化与电活动。

examples.en: We compared ventricular volume at two labeled points within a single cardiac cycle in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂动画中同一个「心动周期」的两个标记时刻对应的心室容积。

words.enDefinition: the part of a heartbeat when the atria contract and add blood to the ventricles

examples.en: The animation shows atrial systole adding the last portion of blood to the ventricles before they contract.
examples.zh: 动画中，「心房收缩期」在心室收缩前将最后一部分血液送入心室。

examples.en: We marked atrial systole after the atrial electrical wave on the timeline of the heartbeat.
examples.zh: 我们在心跳时间线的心房电活动波形后面标出了「心房收缩期」。

words.enDefinition: the phase when the ventricles contract, first raising pressure and then ejecting blood

examples.en: The animation divides ventricular systole into pressure buildup and ejection through the valves at the ventricular outlets.
examples.zh: 动画把「心室收缩期」分为压力升高和血液经心室出口瓣膜射出两个阶段。

examples.en: We traced the ventricular pressure curve as it rose during the early part of ventricular systole.
examples.zh: 我们沿着心室压力曲线观察「心室收缩期」初段的压力升高。

words.enDefinition: the phase when the ventricles relax and then fill with blood

examples.en: During early ventricular diastole, the ventricular pressure fell before the filling valves opened on the model.
examples.zh: 在模型上，「心室舒张期」初段的心室压力在充盈所经的瓣膜打开前下降。

examples.en: The classroom chart shows ventricular volume increasing during the filling portion of ventricular diastole.
examples.zh: 课堂图显示，在「心室舒张期」的充盈阶段，心室容积增加。

words.enDefinition: the brief rise in ventricular pressure when the ventricle contracts while both its inlet and outlet valves are closed

examples.en: During isovolumetric contraction, the ventricular pressure rose while its volume remained unchanged on the example graph.
examples.zh: 在示例图的「等容收缩」阶段，心室压力升高，而容积不变。

examples.en: We marked isovolumetric contraction between closure of the inlet valve and opening of the outlet valve.
examples.zh: 我们在入口瓣膜关闭与出口瓣膜打开之间标出了「等容收缩」。

words.enDefinition: the brief fall in ventricular pressure while the ventricle relaxes with both inlet and outlet valves closed

examples.en: After ejection, isovolumetric relaxation lowered pressure without changing ventricular volume on the classroom graph we studied.
examples.zh: 在我们研究的课堂图上，射血后「等容舒张」使压力下降，心室容积没有改变。

examples.en: We identified isovolumetric relaxation before the inlet valve opened and the next filling phase began.
examples.zh: 我们在入口瓣膜打开、下一轮充盈开始前辨认出了「等容舒张」。

words.enDefinition: the phase when blood exits the ventricle through its open semilunar valve

examples.en: The volume curve fell during ventricular ejection because blood left the chamber in the animated model.
examples.zh: 在动画模型中，血液离开心室，因此「心室射血」期间的容积曲线下降。

examples.en: We marked the start of ventricular ejection where the outlet valve opened on the combined diagram.
examples.zh: 在组合图上，我们在出口瓣膜打开的位置标出「心室射血」的起点。

words.enDefinition: the volume of blood in a ventricle at the end of filling, just before contraction

examples.en: The largest ventricular volume on the example curve was the end-diastolic volume just before contraction began.
examples.zh: 示例曲线上心室的最大容积是收缩开始前的「舒张末期容积」。

examples.en: We compared the marked end-diastolic volume with the blood remaining after the chamber had ejected.
examples.zh: 我们将标出的「舒张末期容积」与心室射血后剩余的血量比较。

words.enDefinition: the volume of blood remaining in a ventricle at the end of contraction and ejection

examples.en: The worksheet labels the volume remaining after ejection as end-systolic volume in the simulated ventricular trace.
examples.zh: 在模拟的心室曲线上，练习把射血后剩余的容积标为「收缩末期容积」。

examples.en: We subtracted end-systolic volume from the volume before contraction to find how much blood the model ejected.
examples.zh: 我们从收缩前的容积减去「收缩末期容积」，求出模型的射血量。

words.enDefinition: the volume of blood ejected by one ventricle during a single heartbeat

examples.en: We found stroke volume by subtracting the volume after ejection from the volume before ventricular contraction.
examples.zh: 我们从心室收缩前的容积减去射血后的容积，得到「每搏输出量」。

examples.en: We compared stroke volume across two model beats while keeping the simulated heart rate the same.
examples.zh: 在模拟心率不变时，我们对照了两次模拟心跳的「每搏输出量」。

words.enDefinition: the volume of blood pumped by one ventricle per unit time, usually per minute

examples.en: We calculated cardiac output by multiplying stroke volume by heart rate in the classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 在课堂模拟中，我们用每搏输出量乘心率求「心输出量」。

examples.en: The model's cardiac output increased when the heart rate rose and the stroke volume remained unchanged.
examples.zh: 心率上升、每搏输出量保持不变时，模型的「心输出量」增加。

words.enDefinition: the fraction of the end-diastolic volume that a ventricle ejects during one contraction

examples.en: We found the ejection fraction by dividing the modeled stroke volume by the end-diastolic volume.
examples.zh: 我们用模型的每搏输出量除以舒张末期容积，求出「射血分数」。

examples.en: The ejection fraction is shown as a percentage beside the two ventricular volumes in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中，「射血分数」以百分数表示，标在两个心室容积旁。

words.enDefinition: the sound associated with closure of the atrioventricular valves near the beginning of ventricular systole

examples.en: The timeline places the first heart sound close to closure of the atrioventricular valves in the animation.
examples.zh: 动画时间线把「第一心音」标在房室瓣关闭的时刻附近。

examples.en: We matched the first heart sound in the supplied recording with the start of pressure buildup.
examples.zh: 我们将给定录音中的「第一心音」对应到心室压力开始升高的时刻。

collocations: timing of the first heart sound

words.enDefinition: the sound associated with closure of the aortic and pulmonary valves near the end of ventricular ejection

examples.en: The class aligned the second heart sound with closure of the outlet valves on the model timeline.
examples.zh: 全班把「第二心音」对齐到模型时间线上的出口瓣膜关闭处。

examples.en: On the sample recording, the second heart sound followed the period during which the ventricles ejected blood.
examples.zh: 在示例录音中，「第二心音」出现在心室射血阶段之后。

collocations: timing of the second heart sound
components of the second heart sound

words.enDefinition: the stretch or load on ventricular muscle at the end of filling before contraction begins

examples.en: The model used end-diastolic volume as an indirect indicator of cardiac preload in the simplified comparison.
examples.zh: 在这项简化比较中，模型用舒张末期容积作为「心脏前负荷」的间接指标。

examples.en: The worksheet shows greater cardiac preload when the ventricular muscle starts from a more stretched state.
examples.zh: 练习表显示，心室肌在起始时拉伸得更多，对应更大的「心脏前负荷」。

collocations: effect of filling on cardiac preload

words.enDefinition: the mechanical load a ventricle must overcome to eject blood during contraction

examples.en: The exercise used arterial pressure as a simple proxy for cardiac afterload on the left ventricle.
examples.zh: 练习把动脉压力作为左心室「心脏后负荷」的一个简化替代指标。

examples.en: Greater cardiac afterload reduced the amount of blood ejected in the model when other inputs stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 其他输入不变时，较大的「心脏后负荷」使模型射出的血液减少。

words.enDefinition: the inherent ability of heart muscle to generate force at a given initial length and loading condition

examples.en: The two simulations used the same filling volume and arterial pressure but different values of myocardial contractility.
examples.zh: 两个模拟采用相同充盈容积与动脉压力，但「心肌收缩性」赋值不同。

examples.en: We changed myocardial contractility in the model to observe its effect on stroke volume at fixed loading.
examples.zh: 我们改变模型中的「心肌收缩性」，观察负荷固定时它对每搏输出量的影响。

words.enDefinition: the intrinsic tendency of the heart to eject more blood when greater ventricular filling stretches myocardial fibers within their physiological range

examples.en: The Frank-Starling mechanism explains the higher stroke volume when the model increases ventricular filling within its normal range.
examples.zh: 「弗兰克–斯塔林机制」解释了模型在正常范围内增加心室充盈时，每搏输出量为何增大。

examples.en: We traced the model curve linking end-diastolic volume to output per beat under the Frank-Starling mechanism.
examples.zh: 我们沿着模型曲线观察「弗兰克–斯塔林机制」如何联系舒张末期容积与每搏输出量。

words.enDefinition: a small arterial vessel that leads toward capillaries and regulates resistance to blood flow

examples.en: The diagram shows an arteriole branching before the blood reaches the narrow capillary network in the tissue.
examples.zh: 图中显示，血液到达组织中狭窄的毛细血管网络前，一条「微动脉」先发生分支。

examples.en: We identified the smooth muscle surrounding the arteriole on the larger image supplied for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习给出的放大图中辨认出包围「微动脉」的平滑肌。

words.enDefinition: a small vessel that collects blood from capillaries and drains it into larger veins

examples.en: The classroom diagram shows the venule collecting blood from several capillaries before joining a larger vein.
examples.zh: 课堂图显示，「微静脉」从多条毛细血管汇集血液，然后汇入较大的静脉。

examples.en: We followed flow from the capillary network toward the venule using the arrows on the model.
examples.zh: 我们顺着模型里的箭头，追踪从毛细血管网络流向「微静脉」的血液。

words.enDefinition: a network of capillaries through which blood passes to exchange substances with surrounding tissues

examples.en: The capillary bed appears as many narrow vessels connecting the arterial and venous ends of the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中的「毛细血管床」由连接动脉侧和静脉侧的许多细小血管组成。

examples.en: We traced how the capillary bed distributes blood through different parts of the classroom tissue model.
examples.zh: 我们追踪「毛细血管床」如何把血液分配到课堂组织模型的不同部位。

collocations: blood flow through a capillary bed

words.enDefinition: the flow of blood back to the heart through veins, often expressed as a volume per unit time

examples.en: The venous return arrow points into the right atrium on the systemic circulation diagram used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的体循环图中，「静脉回流」箭头指向右心房。

examples.en: We compared venous return with cardiac output at steady state in the simplified whole-body model.
examples.zh: 我们在简化的全身模型中比较稳态下的「静脉回流」与心输出量。

collocations: effect of venous return on cardiac filling

words.enDefinition: a fold or set of leaflets in a vein that helps keep blood flowing toward the heart

examples.en: The venous valve opened toward the heart as the pressure below it rose in the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示中，下方压力升高时，「静脉瓣」朝心脏方向打开。

examples.en: We drew the position of a closed venous valve to show where reverse flow was limited.
examples.zh: 我们画出关闭的「静脉瓣」位置，标明反向血流受限之处。

words.enDefinition: the contribution of skeletal muscle contractions and venous valves to moving venous blood toward the heart

examples.en: The model of the skeletal muscle pump shows calf muscles squeezing nearby veins as they shorten.
examples.zh: 「骨骼肌泵」模型显示，小腿肌肉缩短时挤压附近静脉。

examples.en: We added arrows to show how valves guide flow during the action of the skeletal muscle pump.
examples.zh: 我们添加箭头，展示「骨骼肌泵」活动时静脉瓣如何引导血流。

collocations: action of the skeletal muscle pump

words.enDefinition: the difference between systolic and diastolic arterial pressures

examples.en: We found pulse pressure by subtracting the minimum arterial pressure from the peak in the model trace.
examples.zh: 我们用模型曲线上的动脉压力峰值减去最低值，求得「脉压」。

examples.en: The two traces had different pulse pressure values even though they shared a similar average pressure.
examples.zh: 两条曲线的平均压力相近，但「脉压」不同。

words.enDefinition: the time average of arterial pressure over a cardiac cycle

examples.en: The simulator calculated mean arterial pressure from the arterial pressure trace over one complete heartbeat in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，模拟器用一个完整心跳内的动脉压曲线求「平均动脉压」。

examples.en: We compared mean arterial pressure with the highest point on each arterial trace in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们把「平均动脉压」与各条动脉压曲线的最高点比较。

collocations: mean arterial pressure over a beat

words.enDefinition: a short-term feedback response in which arterial stretch receptors help regulate blood pressure

examples.en: The classroom model of the baroreceptor reflex includes signals traveling from stretched arteries toward the brainstem.
examples.zh: 课堂的「压力感受性反射」模型包含从受到牵张的动脉传向脑干的信号。

examples.en: We discussed the baroreceptor reflex after the animation showed a sudden change in modeled arterial pressure.
examples.zh: 动画展示模型动脉压发生突变之后，我们讨论了「压力感受性反射」。

words.enDefinition: the organs and passageways that move air and enable gas exchange between the lungs and blood

examples.en: The respiratory system drawing divides the airflow pathway into upper and lower portions for study.
examples.zh: 「呼吸系统」图将气流通路分成上下两部分供学习。

examples.en: We used an arrow on the respiratory system model to follow air from the nose to the lungs.
examples.zh: 我们在「呼吸系统」模型上用箭头追踪空气从鼻部到肺部的路径。

words.enDefinition: the internal space behind the nose through which air normally passes on its way to the pharynx

examples.en: The sectioned head model shows the nasal cavity lying above the roof of the mouth.
examples.zh: 头部切面模型显示，「鼻腔」位于口腔顶部上方。

examples.en: We followed an arrow through the nasal cavity to the uppermost part of the throat.
examples.zh: 我们沿箭头穿过「鼻腔」，到达咽部最上段。

collocations: air passing through the nasal cavity

words.enDefinition: the muscular passage behind the nasal and oral cavities that connects them with lower throat structures

examples.en: The side view shows the pharynx behind both the nasal cavity and the mouth in the head model.
examples.zh: 侧视图显示，在头部模型中，「咽」位于鼻腔和口腔的后方。

examples.en: We labeled the three regions of the pharynx before tracing the paths of air and swallowed food.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「咽」的三个区域，再追踪空气与吞咽食物各自的路径。

words.enDefinition: the highest part of the pharynx, behind the nasal cavity and above the soft palate

examples.en: The nasopharynx lies behind the nasal cavity and above the soft palate in the classroom section.
examples.zh: 在课堂切面图中，「鼻咽」位于鼻腔后方、软腭上方。

examples.en: We followed the airflow arrow into the nasopharynx at the back of the upper airway model.
examples.zh: 我们沿气流箭头进入上气道模型后方的「鼻咽」。

words.enDefinition: the part of the pharynx behind the mouth through which air and swallowed material can pass

examples.en: The oropharynx appears directly behind the oral cavity on the side-view anatomy illustration shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂展示的侧面解剖图上，「口咽」紧接在口腔后面。

examples.en: We marked the section where both paths crossed the oropharynx on the swallowing and breathing diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在吞咽和呼吸示意图上标出两条路径都经过「口咽」的这一段。

words.enDefinition: the lowest part of the pharynx, behind the larynx and continuing into the esophagus

examples.en: The model places the laryngopharynx below the oropharynx and behind the entrance to the larynx.
examples.zh: 模型将「喉咽」标在口咽下方、喉入口的后方。

examples.en: We found the laryngopharynx just before the pharyngeal passage continued into the esophagus on the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在图上咽通道续接到食管之前的位置找到了「喉咽」。

words.enDefinition: the cartilaginous structure between the pharynx and trachea that houses the vocal folds and helps protect the airway

examples.en: The larynx lies above the trachea in the labeled side view of the classroom anatomy model.
examples.zh: 在有标注的课堂解剖模型侧视图中，「喉」位于气管上方。

examples.en: We found the vocal folds inside the larynx on the enlarged drawing used in the lecture.
examples.zh: 我们在讲座所用的放大图中，在「喉」内找到了声带。

words.enDefinition: a leaf-shaped cartilage near the entrance to the larynx that helps protect the airway during swallowing

examples.en: The swallowing animation shows the epiglottis folding over the laryngeal entrance as the surrounding structures move.
examples.zh: 吞咽动画显示，周围结构移动时，「会厌」向喉入口折下。

examples.en: We recognized the epiglottis by its leaf shape above the vocal folds in the anatomy diagram.
examples.zh: 我们依据声带上方的叶片形状在解剖图中辨认「会厌」。

words.enDefinition: one of two tissue folds in the larynx that vibrate during voice production

examples.en: The sound animation shows each vocal fold vibrating as air passes through the narrowed opening.
examples.zh: 发声动画显示，空气通过变窄的开口时，各「声带」发生振动。

examples.en: We labeled each vocal fold on the diagram before marking the space between the two folds.
examples.zh: 我们在图中先标出各「声带」，再标出两者间的空隙。

words.enDefinition: the region of the larynx formed by the true vocal folds and the opening between them

examples.en: The diagram places the glottis at the level of the true vocal folds in the larynx.
examples.zh: 图中将「声门」标在喉内真声带所在的平面。

examples.en: In the animation, the opening of the glottis widened as the vocal folds moved apart.
examples.zh: 在动画中，随着声带彼此分开，「声门」的开口增大。

words.enDefinition: the airway supported by cartilage that runs from the larynx to the two main bronchi

examples.en: The trachea descends from the larynx and divides near the bottom of the classroom airway model.
examples.zh: 在课堂气道模型中，「气管」起于喉部向下延伸，并在接近底部处分叉。

examples.en: We traced the trachea along the front of the esophagus on the side-view anatomy illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在侧面解剖图上，沿食管前面的「气管」追踪它的走向。

words.enDefinition: the cartilage making up the incomplete rings that help keep the tracheal airway open

examples.en: The classroom cross section shows tracheal cartilage forming most of a ring around the airway.
examples.zh: 课堂横切图显示，「气管软骨」在气道周围形成不完整的环。

examples.en: We saw that the tracheal cartilage opens toward the esophagus in the model of the airway.
examples.zh: 我们看到，气道模型中「气管软骨」环的缺口朝向食管。

words.enDefinition: the internal ridge at the point where the trachea divides into the two main bronchi

examples.en: The carina of the trachea marks the internal ridge between the branches on our enlarged model.
examples.zh: 在放大的模型中，「气管隆嵴」标示出两个分支之间的内部嵴。

examples.en: We placed the label for the carina of the trachea at the airway's first large division.
examples.zh: 我们把「气管隆嵴」标签放在气道的第一个大分叉处。

collocations: identify the carina of the trachea
locate the carina of the trachea
branching at the carina of the trachea

words.enDefinition: one of the two large airway branches carrying air from the trachea into a lung

examples.en: We followed the right main bronchus from the tracheal split to the branching passages within the lung model.
examples.zh: 我们从气管分叉沿右「主支气管」追踪到肺模型内进一步分支的通道。

examples.en: Each main bronchus leads toward one lung and gives rise to branches for its lobes.
examples.zh: 各「主支气管」均通往一侧肺，并分出通往该侧各肺叶的支气管。

words.enDefinition: a branch of a main bronchus that supplies air to one lung lobe

examples.en: The airways diagram shows one lobar bronchus entering each marked lung lobe from a central branch.
examples.zh: 气道图显示，各标记肺叶中都有一条从中央分支延出的「肺叶支气管」。

examples.en: We identified the upper lobar bronchus by following the branch entering the upper lobe of the model.
examples.zh: 我们沿进入模型肺上叶的分支，找出了上叶「肺叶支气管」。

words.enDefinition: a branch of a lobar bronchus that supplies a bronchopulmonary segment

examples.en: The labeled segmental bronchus enters the smaller outlined region within the lobe on our diagram.
examples.zh: 在我们的图中，标注的「肺段支气管」进入肺叶内勾画出的较小区域。

examples.en: We used a color key to link each segmental bronchus with the region it supplies in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用颜色图例将各「肺段支气管」与其供气区域对应起来。

collocations: air supplied by a segmental bronchus

words.enDefinition: a small airway branch in the lungs that lacks cartilage in its wall

examples.en: The model highlights a bronchiole as a narrow continuation of a larger branch within the lung.
examples.zh: 模型突出显示「细支气管」是肺内较大分支向前延伸的一条细小通道。

examples.en: We compared the wall of a bronchiole with that of a cartilage-supported bronchus in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们比较了图谱中「细支气管」管壁与有软骨支撑的支气管管壁。

words.enDefinition: the smallest branch of the conducting zone, immediately preceding the respiratory bronchioles

examples.en: We marked the terminal bronchiole where the last purely conducting airway ends on the class diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上最后一段单纯传导气道的末端标出「终末细支气管」。

examples.en: The sketch shows the terminal bronchiole giving rise to smaller branches with occasional alveoli in their walls.
examples.zh: 示意图显示，「终末细支气管」分出的较小支气管，在管壁上间或出现肺泡。

words.enDefinition: a small airway with alveoli opening from its wall, marking the beginning of the respiratory zone

examples.en: The first scattered wall alveoli identify the respiratory bronchiole in the classroom model of lung branches.
examples.zh: 课堂肺分支模型中，管壁上最先零散出现的肺泡标示出「呼吸性细支气管」。

examples.en: We followed the respiratory bronchiole toward the alveolar ducts at the ends of the model pathways.
examples.zh: 我们沿「呼吸性细支气管」追踪至模型通路末端的肺泡管。

words.enDefinition: the air passages that carry air toward and away from the respiratory zone without participating in pulmonary gas exchange

examples.en: The conducting zone ends at the terminal bronchioles on the map of the airways used in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂使用的气道图上，「传导区」止于终末细支气管。

examples.en: We shaded the nasal cavity and trachea as two examples of structures in the conducting zone.
examples.zh: 我们为鼻腔与气管着色，把它们作为「传导区」结构的两个示例。

words.enDefinition: the lung regions containing alveoli where respiratory gases are exchanged with the blood

examples.en: We highlighted the respiratory zone where the airspaces lie next to networks of pulmonary capillaries in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们突出显示了气腔与肺毛细血管网相邻的「呼吸区」。

examples.en: The alveolar ducts and sacs appear within the respiratory zone on the diagram beside the model.
examples.zh: 在模型旁的图中，肺泡管与肺泡囊都位于「呼吸区」内。

collocations: gas exchange in the respiratory zone

words.enDefinition: a small passage in the respiratory zone with alveoli opening along much of its length

examples.en: In the model, the alveolar duct is lined by openings leading into several small air spaces.
examples.zh: 模型中，「肺泡管」沿线排列着通向多个小气腔的开口。

examples.en: We traced the alveolar duct from a respiratory bronchiole to the air spaces at its end.
examples.zh: 我们从呼吸性细支气管沿「肺泡管」追踪到管末端的气腔。

words.enDefinition: a cluster of alveoli opening into a common space at the end of an alveolar duct

examples.en: The model shows several alveoli sharing the common space of one alveolar sac at the branch end.
examples.zh: 模型显示，分支末端的几个肺泡共用同一个「肺泡囊」内的气腔。

examples.en: We drew a bracket around the cluster to mark the alveolar sac on the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图的成簇结构外画上括号，标出「肺泡囊」。

words.enDefinition: one of the tiny air sacs in the lungs whose thin walls allow exchange of gases with capillaries

examples.en: Each pulmonary alveolus in the enlarged model is surrounded by a network of very small blood vessels.
examples.zh: 放大的模型中，每个「肺泡」都由极细的血管网包围。

examples.en: We drew oxygen crossing the wall of a pulmonary alveolus toward an adjacent capillary in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们画出氧穿过一个「肺泡」的壁，进入邻近毛细血管。

collocations: gas exchange in a pulmonary alveolus

words.enDefinition: a thin alveolar lining cell that covers most of the alveolar surface and supports gas diffusion

examples.en: The flattened type I pneumocyte lies along the thin gas exchange surface in the magnified lung diagram.
examples.zh: 放大的肺组织图中，扁平的「Ⅰ型肺泡上皮细胞」沿薄薄的气体交换面排列。

examples.en: We identified the type I pneumocyte by its broad surface and thin profile on the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们依据图中宽大的表面与很薄的侧面轮廓，辨认「Ⅰ型肺泡上皮细胞」。

collocations: surface covered by a type I pneumocyte

words.enDefinition: an alveolar cell that produces pulmonary surfactant and can contribute to repair of the alveolar lining

examples.en: The cuboidal type II pneumocyte stood out beside thin lining cells in the enlarged alveolar diagram.
examples.zh: 在放大的肺泡图中，立方形的「Ⅱ型肺泡上皮细胞」在薄薄的衬里细胞旁很醒目。

examples.en: We linked the type II pneumocyte to surfactant production in a diagram summarizing alveolar cell functions.
examples.zh: 在概括肺泡细胞功能的图中，我们将「Ⅱ型肺泡上皮细胞」与表面活性物质的生成相联系。

collocations: surfactant from a type II pneumocyte

words.enDefinition: a mixture lining the alveoli that lowers surface tension and helps stabilize these airspaces

examples.en: The lecture model showed how pulmonary surfactant lowers surface tension at the air-liquid boundary in each alveolus.
examples.zh: 课堂模型演示「肺表面活性物质」如何降低各肺泡气液界面的表面张力。

examples.en: We labeled the layer containing pulmonary surfactant at the boundary between alveolar air and lining fluid.
examples.zh: 我们在肺泡内空气与衬层液体的交界处标出含「肺表面活性物质」的一层。

collocations: effect of pulmonary surfactant on surface tension

words.enDefinition: the thin barrier through which oxygen and carbon dioxide diffuse between alveolar air and capillary blood

examples.en: We marked the respiratory membrane between the airspace and the capillary lumen in the enlarged model.
examples.zh: 我们在放大模型上，标出气腔与毛细血管腔之间的「呼吸膜」。

examples.en: The diagram shows carbon dioxide crossing the respiratory membrane in the opposite direction from oxygen.
examples.zh: 图中二氧化碳穿过「呼吸膜」的方向与氧相反。

words.enDefinition: a tiny blood vessel in the lungs that forms part of the exchange network around alveoli

examples.en: We drew a pulmonary capillary close to the alveolar wall to illustrate the short distance for gas exchange.
examples.zh: 我们在肺泡壁旁画出一条「肺毛细血管」，展示气体交换距离很短。

examples.en: The animation shows blood gaining oxygen as it crosses a pulmonary capillary beside the modeled alveolus.
examples.zh: 动画显示，血液经过模型肺泡旁的一条「肺毛细血管」时获得氧。

collocations: blood flowing through a pulmonary capillary

words.enDefinition: one of the major divisions of a lung, separated from neighboring lobes by fissures

examples.en: The right lung model shows each lung lobe separated from the next by a marked fissure.
examples.zh: 右肺模型用标出的裂隙将相邻的「肺叶」分别隔开。

examples.en: We identified the left upper lung lobe by its position above the oblique fissure on the model.
examples.zh: 我们依据模型上左肺斜裂以上的位置，辨认出左上「肺叶」。

words.enDefinition: a deep cleft separating adjacent lobes of a lung

examples.en: The lung fissure appears as a groove separating two lobes in the classroom model of the lungs.
examples.zh: 课堂肺模型中，「肺裂」表现为分隔两个肺叶的沟。

examples.en: We located the lung fissure marked as oblique on the side view of the left lung.
examples.zh: 我们在左肺侧视图中找到了标为斜裂的那条「肺裂」。

words.enDefinition: the region on the medial lung surface through which the bronchi, vessels, nerves and lymphatic pathways pass

examples.en: The model places the lung hilum on the inward-facing surface where the major airway and vessels enter.
examples.zh: 模型把「肺门」标在面向内侧的表面，大气道和血管从这里出入。

examples.en: We labeled the lung hilum after locating the group of structures entering the lung in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找到出入肺部的一组结构，再标出「肺门」。

collocations: structures passing through the lung hilum

words.enDefinition: an indentation along the anterior border of the left lung that makes room for the heart

examples.en: The cardiac notch forms a visible indentation along the front edge of the left lung model.
examples.zh: 「心切迹」在左肺模型的前缘形成一个可见的凹陷。

examples.en: We matched the position of the cardiac notch with the nearby outline of the heart in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「心切迹」的位置与图中相邻的心脏轮廓对应起来。

collocations: cardiac notch of the left lung

words.enDefinition: the thin serous membrane covering the surface of a lung and extending into its fissures

examples.en: The visceral pleura follows the lung surface into the fissure drawn on the classroom cross section.
examples.zh: 在课堂横切图中，「脏层胸膜」沿肺表面进入肺裂。

examples.en: We shaded the visceral pleura directly on the model lung before marking the membrane lining the chest wall.
examples.zh: 我们先给模型肺表面的「脏层胸膜」着色，再标出胸壁内侧的那一层膜。

collocations: surface covered by the visceral pleura

words.enDefinition: the serous membrane lining the inside of the chest wall, diaphragm and sides of the mediastinum

examples.en: The parietal pleura follows the inside of the chest wall in the labeled drawing for class.
examples.zh: 课堂标注图显示，「壁层胸膜」沿胸壁内侧分布。

examples.en: We drew the parietal pleura against the inner chest boundary, opposite the layer covering the lung.
examples.zh: 我们将「壁层胸膜」画在胸腔内壁，位于肺表面那层膜的对侧。

collocations: parietal pleura lining the chest wall

words.enDefinition: the small amount of liquid between the pleural layers that allows them to slide with low friction

examples.en: The model shows pleural fluid as a thin film between the moving lung and chest wall layers.
examples.zh: 模型中的「胸膜液」表现为移动的肺表面膜与胸壁内衬膜之间的一层薄膜状液体。

examples.en: We used pleural fluid to explain how the two surfaces slide smoothly in the classroom breathing model.
examples.zh: 我们用「胸膜液」解释课堂呼吸模型中的两个表面如何平滑滑动。

words.enDefinition: a dome-shaped muscle separating the chest and abdomen that is the main muscle of quiet inhalation

examples.en: In the animation, the diaphragm moved downward as it contracted and enlarged the chest cavity.
examples.zh: 动画中，「膈肌」收缩时向下移动，使胸腔扩大。

examples.en: We traced the curved resting outline of the diaphragm beneath both lungs on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图中沿两侧肺下方描出「膈肌」舒张时的弧形轮廓。

words.enDefinition: one of the muscles between the ribs that typically helps raise the ribs during inspiration

examples.en: The anatomy model shows an external intercostal muscle filling the space between two ribs in the chest wall.
examples.zh: 解剖模型上，一处「肋间外肌」位于胸壁的两根肋骨之间。

examples.en: We linked contraction of an external intercostal muscle with elevation of the ribs in the inhalation animation.
examples.zh: 我们在吸气动画中，将「肋间外肌」收缩与肋骨抬高联系起来。

words.enDefinition: the movement of air into the lungs when alveolar pressure falls below atmospheric pressure

examples.en: During quiet inspiration, the chest cavity expanded and air entered the lungs in the classroom animation.
examples.zh: 课堂动画中，平静「吸气」时胸腔扩大，空气进入肺内。

examples.en: We marked inspiration on the rising part of the lung volume trace in the breathing exercise.
examples.zh: 在呼吸练习的肺容积曲线上，我们在上升段标出「吸气」。

words.enDefinition: the movement of air out of the lungs when alveolar pressure exceeds atmospheric pressure

examples.en: During quiet expiration, elastic recoil reduced the lung volume and moved air out in our model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，平静「呼气」时弹性回缩使肺容积减小，空气流出。

examples.en: We marked expiration on the descending part of the lung volume trace in the breathing exercise.
examples.zh: 在呼吸练习的肺容积曲线上，我们在下降段标出「呼气」。

words.enDefinition: pressure within the narrow potential space between the visceral and parietal pleura

examples.en: The graph shows intrapleural pressure becoming more negative during quiet inspiration in the simple lung model.
examples.zh: 在简化肺模型中，平静吸气时图上的「胸膜腔内压」变得更负。

examples.en: We plotted intrapleural pressure separately from the pressure inside the alveoli during the same modeled breath.
examples.zh: 在模型表现的同一次呼吸中，我们分别绘出「胸膜腔内压」和肺泡内压。

words.enDefinition: the pressure within the gas spaces of the alveoli

examples.en: The alveolar pressure briefly fell below the plotted atmospheric reference when air entered the model lung.
examples.zh: 空气进入模型肺时，「肺泡压」短暂低于图上标出的参考大气压。

examples.en: We checked when alveolar pressure returned to atmospheric pressure at the end of the simulated breath.
examples.zh: 我们核对了模拟呼吸末段「肺泡压」何时恢复到大气压。

words.enDefinition: the difference between alveolar pressure and pleural pressure, representing a distending pressure across the lung

examples.en: We calculated transpulmonary pressure from the difference between alveolar pressure and pleural pressure in the example.
examples.zh: 我们用示例中肺泡压与胸膜腔内压之差算出「跨肺压」。

examples.en: The model plot links a higher transpulmonary pressure with a larger lung volume at static equilibrium.
examples.zh: 模型图显示，在静态平衡时，较高的「跨肺压」对应较大的肺容积。

words.enDefinition: the change in lung volume per unit change in distending pressure across the lung

examples.en: Higher lung compliance gave a greater volume change for the same pressure change in the simulated lung.
examples.zh: 模拟肺中，「肺顺应性」越高，相同压差变化对应的容积变化越大。

examples.en: We estimated lung compliance from the local slope of the volume versus transpulmonary pressure curve in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用肺容积对跨肺压曲线的局部斜率估算「肺顺应性」。

words.enDefinition: the tendency of expanded lungs to return toward a smaller size when distending forces decrease

examples.en: The model represents elastic recoil with an inward arrow on the expanded lung after the breath in.
examples.zh: 在吸气结束的膨胀肺上，模型用一支朝内的箭头表示「弹性回缩」。

examples.en: We linked elastic recoil with the decrease in lung volume during quiet expiration in the simulation.
examples.zh: 我们把「弹性回缩」与模拟中平静呼气时的肺容积减少联系起来。

words.enDefinition: opposition to airflow through the respiratory passages, expressed as pressure difference divided by airflow under stated conditions

examples.en: The narrower branch had greater airway resistance than the wider branch in the simplified model.
examples.zh: 在简化模型中，较窄分支的「气道阻力」比更宽分支大。

examples.en: We compared airway resistance by finding the pressure difference needed for the same flow in both models.
examples.zh: 我们求出两种模型达到相同流量所需的压差，从而比较「气道阻力」。

words.enDefinition: the movement of air between the atmosphere and the lungs through inhalation and exhalation

examples.en: The animation illustrates pulmonary ventilation by showing air moving into and out of the expanding lungs.
examples.zh: 动画通过展示空气进出正在扩张和回缩的肺，演示「肺通气」。

examples.en: We separated pulmonary ventilation from gas diffusion across the alveolar wall when labeling the two diagrams.
examples.zh: 给两张图作标记时，我们区分了「肺通气」与气体通过肺泡壁扩散。

words.enDefinition: the volume of air inhaled or exhaled in one breath, commonly referring to an ordinary quiet breath

examples.en: We measured tidal volume on the simulated trace by comparing its level before and after quiet inspiration.
examples.zh: 我们比较模拟曲线在平静吸气前后的数值，测得「潮气量」。

examples.en: The classroom model showed a larger tidal volume when each simulated breath moved more air.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，每次模拟呼吸移动的空气更多时，「潮气量」也更大。

words.enDefinition: the additional volume that can be inhaled after an ordinary inspiration

examples.en: The graph marks inspiratory reserve volume between lung volumes after a quiet breath in and maximal inhalation.
examples.zh: 图中将平静吸气后与最大吸气后的肺容积之差标为「吸气储备量」。

examples.en: We drew a bracket for inspiratory reserve volume above the normal breathing range on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习的正常呼吸范围上方用括号标出「吸气储备量」。

collocations: inspiratory reserve volume on a tracing

words.enDefinition: the additional volume that can be exhaled after an ordinary expiration

examples.en: We located expiratory reserve volume below the quiet breathing range on the lung volume chart in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在肺容积图中平静呼吸范围下方标出了「呼气储备量」。

examples.en: The lower bracket shows expiratory reserve volume between the ends of quiet exhalation and maximum exhalation.
examples.zh: 下方括号表示从平静呼气结束到最大呼气结束之间的「呼气储备量」。

collocations: expiratory reserve volume on a tracing

words.enDefinition: the air volume remaining in the lungs after the fullest possible expiration

examples.en: The diagram labels residual volume below the level reached at the end of a maximal exhalation.
examples.zh: 示意图将最大呼气后仍留在肺内的气体容积标为「残气量」。

examples.en: We noted that the simple simulated spirometer trace could not directly show the residual volume.
examples.zh: 我们注意到，模拟的普通肺量计曲线无法直接显示「残气量」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum volume of air that can be exhaled after a maximal inhalation

examples.en: The bracket shows vital capacity between the maximum and minimum lung volumes on the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 课程图表上的括号标出了最大与最小肺容积之差，也就是「肺活量」。

examples.en: We compared vital capacity with tidal volume to distinguish the full movable volume from one quiet breath.
examples.zh: 我们将「肺活量」和潮气量作比较，区分最大可出入气量与一次平静呼吸的气量。

words.enDefinition: the volume of air remaining in the lungs at the end of a normal quiet expiration

examples.en: The chart marks functional residual capacity at the end of each quiet expiration in the model.
examples.zh: 图表在模型每次平静呼气结束时所处的容积标出「功能残气量」。

examples.en: We found functional residual capacity by adding expiratory reserve volume and residual volume in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习中，我们将呼气储备量与残气量相加，求得「功能残气量」。

words.enDefinition: the volume of air contained in the lungs at the end of a maximal inspiration

examples.en: The top dashed line represents total lung capacity on the classroom chart for the modeled lung.
examples.zh: 课堂模型肺的图表上，最上面的虚线代表「肺总量」。

examples.en: We calculated total lung capacity by adding vital capacity to residual volume in the example exercise.
examples.zh: 在示例练习中，我们用肺活量加残气量求得「肺总量」。

words.enDefinition: the total volume of air moved in or out of the lungs per minute

examples.en: We found minute ventilation by multiplying the model's tidal volume by the number of breaths per minute.
examples.zh: 我们将模型的潮气量乘每分钟呼吸次数，求出「每分钟通气量」。

examples.en: The two simulations had equal minute ventilation despite using different combinations of breath size and frequency.
examples.zh: 两个模拟采用不同的单次呼吸量与频率组合，所得「每分钟通气量」相同。

words.enDefinition: the volume of fresh air reaching alveoli available for gas exchange per unit time

examples.en: The model used alveolar ventilation to track fresh air delivered to exchanging regions per minute.
examples.zh: 模型用「肺泡通气量」表示每分钟送入气体交换区的新鲜空气量。

examples.en: At equal minute ventilation and fixed dead space per breath, deeper breaths gave greater alveolar ventilation.
examples.zh: 在每分钟通气量相同、每次呼吸的无效腔容积恒定时，较深呼吸产生更高的「肺泡通气量」。

words.enDefinition: the volume of the conducting airways where no exchange of respiratory gases takes place

examples.en: The model colors the anatomical dead space from the nose down to the last purely conducting branches.
examples.zh: 模型为从鼻部到最后一级单纯传导分支的「解剖无效腔」着色。

examples.en: We subtracted anatomical dead space from tidal volume when estimating fresh air entering alveoli in the ideal model.
examples.zh: 在理想模型中估算进入肺泡的新鲜空气时，我们从潮气量中减去「解剖无效腔」容积。

words.enDefinition: the total ventilated volume that does not effectively exchange gases, including conducting airway volume and alveolar dead space

examples.en: The model's physiological dead space included both the conducting airways and alveoli with ineffective gas exchange.
examples.zh: 模型中的「生理无效腔」既包括传导气道，也包括不能有效交换气体的肺泡。

examples.en: We compared physiological dead space with anatomical dead space in a classroom diagram showing uneven blood flow.
examples.zh: 我们用显示血流分布不均的课堂图，对比「生理无效腔」与解剖无效腔。

collocations: compare physiological dead space with anatomical dead space

words.enDefinition: the ratio of alveolar ventilation to blood flow through the same lung region or whole lung

examples.en: In the model, the ventilation-perfusion ratio rose when ventilation increased while the local blood flow stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 在模型中，局部血流保持不变且通气量增加时，「通气血流比」升高。

examples.en: We compared the ventilation-perfusion ratio in two regions using modeled alveolar airflow and pulmonary blood flow rates.
examples.zh: 我们用模型中的肺泡气流量和肺血流量比较两个区域的「通气血流比」。

words.enDefinition: the diffusion of oxygen and carbon dioxide between the alveoli and the pulmonary capillary blood

examples.en: The arrows for pulmonary gas exchange show oxygen entering the blood and carbon dioxide entering the alveoli.
examples.zh: 「肺气体交换」的箭头显示，氧进入血液，二氧化碳进入肺泡。

examples.en: We used the short distance between air and blood to explain pulmonary gas exchange in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们用气腔和血液之间的短距离来解释课堂模型中的「肺气体交换」。

words.zhGloss: 氧合血红蛋白解离曲线
words.enDefinition: a graph showing the relationship between oxygen partial pressure and hemoglobin oxygen saturation under stated conditions
acceptedZhAnswers: 氧合血红蛋白解离曲线

examples.en: We read the saturation at the marked oxygen pressure on the oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation curve in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在「氧合血红蛋白解离曲线」上，读出标记氧分压对应的饱和度。

examples.en: The oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation curve had a steeper middle section than the plateau in the model plot.
examples.zh: 模型图上的「氧合血红蛋白解离曲线」在中段比平台段更陡。

collocations: shift of the oxygen-hemoglobin dissociation curve

words.enDefinition: the reduction in hemoglobin's oxygen affinity as carbon dioxide rises or pH falls, favoring oxygen release

examples.en: The model illustrates the Bohr effect with a lower oxygen saturation at the same oxygen pressure after acidification.
examples.zh: 模型通过酸度增加后同一氧分压下的饱和度降低，展示了「波尔效应」。

examples.en: We used the Bohr effect to explain why the modeled hemoglobin released more oxygen at lower pH.
examples.zh: 我们用「波尔效应」解释模拟血红蛋白在 pH 较低时为何释放更多氧。

collocations: oxygen release associated with the Bohr effect
